_comment: Hand edits for ranks 5001-10000 of the Italian deck (tools/extend_deck_italian.py). _drop removes a lemma from the extension; _keep exempts a lemma from the stricter filters (nationalities, religions, loanwords); _gender freezes the reviewed gender of every new noun (m = masculine noun, f = feminine noun, mf = noun (m/f)); other keys override the automatic gloss / pos / posName. Only ranks 5001+ are affected; the first 5,000 cards are never touched.
